detailed_descriptions_html.en:
【STORY】

─The setting is on a certain continent.
The mercenary Noah went on a wandering journey in order to meet his brother again.

At the end of the long adventure, she finally knew where her brother lived and set her sights on his kingdom.
However, during this journey, she heard rumors about the thieves group in the item shop where she came to replenish props...

"The result of being caught by them is that men will be used as slaves until they die..."

Because of their extremely vicious behavior, Noah, who was filled with anger, ignored the store owner's words and went to find the thieves.
 

【Game Contents】

  • A base of the worst nightmares. Try to escape before your soul is destroyed...

After being caught by thieves using dirty means and waking up again, Noah was already imprisoned.

She had to find a way to escape from here before she was discovered...

※This game is a sneaking game where you need to find the exit without being discovered by thieves. There is no combat content.

  • The imprisoned Noah, the fate waiting for her will be...

If her true secret is discovered, she will begin to live a daily life of humiliation.
Of course, if she continues to live like this every day, she will eventually...

──Can she escape from this fate?

 

【Protagonist】

  • Noah

A wandering mercenary who continues to travel in order to meet her separated brother again.
Although her swordsmanship is unparalleled, her lack of caution is her shortcoming.
She has a strong sense of justice and cannot leave people in trouble alone.

 

【Supporting characters】

  • Olivia

A religious nun. During the missionary activities, she was captured by a group of thieves like Noah. Although she is a lady with a gentle and loving spirit, she does not know how to deal with men because of her belief, so when she is treated rudely by the thieves, she will immediately cry and scream.

 

Will the end of the nightmares be filled with hope, or——...
